title: Install-timer run record
description: One measured install (blueprint §16 step 6, §12.2). core_ready_ms is WELCOME → READY wall-clock time with human prompts included. async_post_core holds everything §0 lists as happening after core-ready (model downloads, OAuth, permissions, Tailscale, …) and is structurally separate: no field in this document sums it into core_ready_ms, and async_post_core.counted_in_core_ready_ms is the constant false.

schema_version.description: Record schema version. Minor adds optional fields; major removes, renames, retypes or changes an enum.

run_id.description: ULID assigned when the record is written. Also the file name suffix.

synthetic.description: True for generated or illustrative data. Synthetic records are excluded from aggregate by default and never count toward the gate.

profile.description: §12.2 machine profile: mac-a = clean M4 Max 36–64 GB, mac-b = clean M3 Ultra, other = any machine outside the two gated profiles (developer Macs, CI runners).

memory_gb.description: sysctl hw.memsize rounded to whole GiB.

runtime_cached.description: True when the signed runtime bundle was already on disk / in the page cache before WELCOME (ADR-001 E3: first launch after signing costs ~3.5 s extra). §0 states the target for cached runtimes; uncached runs are reported separately.

clean_machine.description: True only when the operator asserts the clean-machine protocol in docs/operations/install-measurement.md was followed. Runs with false are reported but never gate.

scenario.description: Only fresh_install runs count toward the §12.2 timing gate; other scenarios are timed for coverage.

product_version.description: Product version of the DMG under test (docs/operations/release-policy.md §2).

commit.description: Git commit the DMG was built from.

started_at.description: Timestamp of the WELCOME event: the installer's Welcome screen is on screen.

ready_at.description: Timestamp of the READY event: /health/ready returned ready: true and the Done screen is on screen.

core_ready_ms.description: ready_at − started_at. The §12.2 gated number. Includes human prompts and runtime initialisation; excludes every async post-core step by construction.

human_interaction_ms.description: Sum of human_interactions[].duration_ms. Already inside core_ready_ms; reported as its own phase per §12.2.

automated_ms.description: core_ready_ms − human_interaction_ms: time the installer spent working while nobody was being asked anything.

dmg_open_to_welcome_ms.description: Informational: DMG_OPEN → WELCOME when the operator timed the DMG open and Gatekeeper check. Not part of core_ready_ms; reported so it cannot be hidden.

phases.description: One entry per §12.1 state in order; a state's duration ends when the next state is entered, and HEALTH_CHECK ends at READY. Durations sum to core_ready_ms.

human_interactions.description: Every interval between human_interaction_start and human_interaction_end inside the core window.

counted_in_core_ready_ms.description: Always false. Exists so a reader of the JSON cannot miss that these numbers are outside core_ready_ms.

steps.description: Keyed by step name: the §12.1 optional path (CONNECT_EMAIL, CONNECT_GITHUB, PEEKABOO_PERMISSIONS, REMOTE_ACCESS, SCHEDULE_BRIEF) and the §0 list (MODEL_DOWNLOAD, OAUTH_GOOGLE, OAUTH_MICROSOFT, OAUTH_GITHUB, ICLOUD_MAIL, HEY, TAILSCALE_LOGIN, IOS_PUSH, EMAIL_VERIFICATION). Network-conditional; reported separately.

notes.description: Free text from the operator. No personal data.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time in this state, human prompts included.

human_ms.description: Portion of duration_ms during which a human prompt was open.

during_state.description: The installer state that was active when the prompt opened.

outcome.description: incomplete = still running when the record was written (ended_at and duration_ms are null).

overlaps_core_window.description: True when the step started before READY. The step still does not count toward core_ready_ms, but an installer that blocks core-ready on such a step is a §0 violation and must be fixed, not re-labelled.
